changes.question: Name Microsoft’s reportable segments in this filing.
new: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing

changes.question: Which reportable segment includes LinkedIn?
new: LinkedIn, including Talent Solutions

changes.question: Which reportable segment includes Azure and other cloud services?
new: Server products and cloud services, including Azure and other cloud services

changes.question: Which reportable segment includes Xbox hardware and Xbox content and services?
new: Gaming, including Xbox hardware and Xbox content and services

changes.question: What categories make up Microsoft Cloud revenue as defined in the filing?
new: Microsoft Cloud revenue, which includes Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud

changes.question: What does revenue allocated to remaining performance obligations include?
new: includes unearned revenue and amounts expected to be invoiced

changes.question: Which investment-related items are excluded from the adjusted net income and adjusted diluted EPS measures?
new: exclude net gains and losses from investments in OpenAI

changes.question: What accounting method does Microsoft use for its OpenAI investment, and what method is used to calculate its equity-method income or loss?
new: accounted for under the equity method of accounting
hypothetical liquidation at book value

changes.question: How does Microsoft define cash equivalents in its investment policy?
new: highly liquid interest-earning investments with a maturity of three months or less

changes.question: For the quarter ended March 31, 2026, contrast the reported revenue trends in Intelligent Cloud and More Personal Computing, including their principal drivers.
new: Intelligent Cloud revenue increased driven by Azure
More Personal Computing revenue decreased with lower hardware sales across Devices and Gaming

changes.question: How did Microsoft’s reported quarterly gross-margin-percentage trends differ between Productivity and Business Processes and Intelligent Cloud?
new: Gross margin percentage increased slightly driven by efficiency gains in Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud
Gross margin percentage decreased driven by the continued investments in AI infrastructure, offset in part by efficiency gains in Azure

changes.question: Compare Microsoft’s explanations for More Personal Computing revenue in the three-month and nine-month periods ended March 31, 2026.
new: More Personal Computing revenue decreased with lower hardware sales across Devices and Gaming
More Personal Computing revenue was relatively unchanged with growth in Search advertising offset by a decline in Gaming

changes.question: Contrast the main drivers of Microsoft’s higher effective tax rate in the three-month and nine-month periods ended March 31, 2026.
new: changes in the mix of our earnings and tax expenses between the U.S. and foreign countries
deferred tax expense attributable to the dilution gain from the OpenAI Recapitalization

changes.question: Compare the directions of the OpenAI investment effects on current-year quarterly versus nine-month net income and diluted EPS.
new: Current year net income and diluted EPS were negatively impacted by net losses from investments in OpenAI
Current year net income and diluted EPS were positively impacted by net gains from investments in OpenAI

changes.question: Contrast the stated drivers of nine-month operating cash flow and investing cash outflow changes versus the prior year.
new: increase in cash received from customers and a decrease in cash used to pay income taxes
increase in additions to property and equipment

changes.question: Reconcile Microsoft’s change in cash and cash equivalents for the nine months ended March 31, 2026 using operating, financing, investing, and foreign-exchange cash flows. Then reconcile the ending cash balance to the balance sheet. Use USD millions.

Reconcile the three segments’ year-over-year quarterly revenue changes to Microsoft’s total change for the three months ended March 31, 2026. Calculate Intelligent Cloud’s share of the net total increase and explain its primary driver.
new: Intelligent Cloud revenue increased driven by Azure

changes.question: Explain why More Personal Computing’s quarterly operating income increased even though its revenue decreased. Connect the consolidated revenue narrative with the segment’s cost and margin explanations.
new: primarily driven by lower hardware sales
Gross margin percentage increased driven by sales mix shift to higher margin businesses

changes.question: Explain how Microsoft’s quarterly gross margin in dollars could increase while its gross margin percentage decreased. Use the income statement and management’s reported drivers without assuming that margin dollars and margin percentage are the same measure.
new: Gross margin increased $7.9 billion or 16%
Gross margin percentage decreased driven by continued investments in AI infrastructure and growing AI product usage

changes.question: Why should Microsoft Cloud revenue not be added to the reportable segments’ revenues when constructing total company revenue? Identify the relevant components and explain the overlap.
new: Microsoft Cloud revenue, which includes Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud
Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing

changes.question: Connect the OpenAI recapitalization accounting with the nine-month GAAP versus adjusted net-income comparison. Why does excluding OpenAI effects reduce current-year net income but increase prior-year net income?
new: recorded a dilution gain
Current year net income and diluted EPS were positively impacted by net gains from investments in OpenAI
exclude net gains and losses from investments in OpenAI
